interface_type_note: Focused current AdviserApp core-flow review UX-01 through UX-06; source inspection and dark web preview, not native certification. Parts 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 considered; AI is reviewed separately. Score covers only these six findings. Unpublished principle codes are null rather than invented; upstream code-format instructions are internally inconsistent.

findings.message: AdviserApp.tsx confirm() sends invalid-budget feedback to a background notice while the modal stays open. Entering 0 reproduced no inline error; closing the form revealed the message. Detail-save acknowledgement is similarly outside the active modal.
findings.remediation: Render and announce field errors inside the form, focus the invalid field, preserve the draft, and show save results on the active detail surface. Verify invalid values and failed persistence.

findings.message: AdviserApp.tsx lines 711-718 and 781-785 immediately persist individual or bulk history deletion. No confirmation, undo or restore path exists in this flow. Identified from source; deletion was not executed.
findings.remediation: Provide reversible single-delete or a clear confirmation; bulk deletion must show count and cancel action. Verify recovery and persistence failure.

findings.message: The shared button exposes disabled state only; RAM, storage, source and task choices communicate selection through color. Browser needs-form options expose no checked/selected/pressed state. TalkBack was not tested.
findings.remediation: Use labelled radio groups for single choices and checkbox/toggle semantics for multiple tasks, plus a visible non-color selection indicator. Verify with TalkBack and external keyboard.

findings.message: Empty input outlines measure 1.29-1.41:1 in light and 1.65-2.01:1 in dark against adjacent surfaces. The purple web focus outline measures 1.82-2.22:1 in dark. These essential cues miss 3:1 although normal text pairs pass.
findings.remediation: Separate essential outline from decorative divider roles and use theme-aware focus colors achieving at least 3:1 on actual adjacent surfaces. Keep disabled exceptions and decorative borders out of the failure count.

findings.message: Searching zzzz-no-product shows a no-requirements-match message and only a change-needs CTA. AdviserApp.tsx lines 653-660 conflate no search/source matches with no eligible candidates.
findings.remediation: Use distinct empty states and clear-search/clear-filter actions while preserving confirmed needs. Verify restoring results without relaxing budget.

findings.message: The comparison view renders two long summary strings as stacked cards, with full URLs and timestamps. Values are not aligned; remove/replace controls are absent in this view.
findings.remediation: Render comparable labelled attribute rows with stable product identities, explicit unknowns and remove/replace actions. Use side-by-side layout on expanded windows and progressive disclosure for long sources.

strengths.message: The needs card has a clear heading and prominent editing CTA. Most current opaque text pairs exceed 4.5:1.
Requirements changes use a separate draft and explicit confirmation. Source/tests protect committed state against failed writes.
Historical prices, source dates, unknown costs and unverified suitability are visibly disclosed.

api_note: UXUI_API_KEY was absent. Internal-knowledge review only; no paid API or complete live taxonomy audit was performed. See https://uxuiprinciples.com/en/checkout for optional enrichment.
